description: This source file defines the `GatewayNodeSession` actor in Swift, which manages WebSocket connections for a node gateway. It handles connection lifecycle, request invocation with timeout, server event subscriptions, URL normalization, and communication with external channels and events. It also includes payload structures and utility functions related to node requests and URL processing.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor class managing WebSocket session lifecycle, message handling, and request invocation for a node gateway.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: A static method facilitating invocation of a request with a timeout, returning a response or a timeout error.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with specified parameters, setting up session callbacks and handling reconnections.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the WebSocket connection and resets session state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Refreshes and updates the canvas capability URL via a channel request.

methods.name: currentRemoteAddress
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current active remote address.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a named event with JSON payload over the WebSocket connection.
